report.scope: Exact-source and retained-failure inspection only. No builds, models, tests, verification runs, new measurements, quality computation, parameter changes, data changes or source repairs.

shared_error.meaning: Pivot 11 in the computed 11x11 covariance fails the strictly-positive finite-precision factorization test. The error alone does not distinguish zero, negative, NaN, or the mathematical condition of the unrounded covariance.

findings: The B follow-up invokes the same saved worker recipe and selects its original B arm. It preserves the candidate failure and stops on the failed B warmup, before a scored execution. Stored queue/collector SHA256 values match the retained queue and script.

Frozen recipe uses the entire saved 5,250,086 x 11 fit matrix, full covariance, 8 components, n_init=1, kmeans initialization, seed=7, reg_covar=1e-6, tol=1e-3, max_iter=100. No source setting substitution was established.

bench_board_more.py passes Taxi reg_covar=1e-6 into GaussianMixture. mixture.py argument index 5 agrees with bindings/_mojolearn_mixture.mojo, which converts it to Float32 and places it in GmmParams.reg_covar.

The fit driver forwards reg_covar to initial and iterative M-steps. cov_finish_kernel divides by component mass first, then adds reg_covar only to the diagonal. No omitted or mis-scaled regularization defect was found in this source path.

Both arms retain the incumbent IDENTICAL fused-Cholesky default; B is not an all-switches-off build. The kernel tests pv>0, writes j+1 on failure, and returns before inversion. The host consumes the first failed component in ascending order and raises; the source intentionally does not reset or continue a failed component.

Because the error says EM iteration 1, the source path passed initialization factorization and failed the first iterative M-step factorization. The message alone is not proof of singleton component size or a particular roundoff cause.

At finite Float32 precision, a nominal positive diagonal ridge is not a guarantee that the computed factorization succeeds. This is a plausible conditioning/rounding explanation, not a reconstructed covariance diagnosis.
The same retained refusal on B prevents treating this as an isolated new-candidate regression. No concrete pointer, settings, covariance formula or refusal-status bug was established.
